selectedCoordinate.name: ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE
selectedCoordinate.component_identity: Joint canonicalization of frontier-relative residual incidence with one remaining-capacity parity bit H-h_c mod 2 attached to each local incidence column role.
selectedCoordinate.count_state: After aggregation by that structural identity: omit zero multiplicity, O for positive odd multiplicity, E for positive even multiplicity.

findings.statement: Attaching only remaining-capacity parity to each REL_INC column role is sufficient for ZOE scalar class purity on every demanding derivation carrier.
Unaligned exact capacity profiles can fail while role-aligned capacity parity passes, so the association between support-height parity and residual-incidence column role is load-bearing.
Predeclared outcome-blind 6x3-k4 has 3,543 exact-rank affine component-parity contradictions but zero ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE mixed scalar classes across 1,661,439 T2-O states.
On fresh 6x3-k4 ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE has 17,550 scalar classes versus 18,418 exact-type ZOE classes and 18,437 full-multiplicity classes, while remaining Q-V exact.
Exact role-aligned capacity plus REL_INC induces the same class count as exact-type ZOE on every derivation carrier and fresh 6x3-k4, validating the descriptor reconstruction boundary.

narrowed_or_superseded: The stale foundational boundary naming 5x4-k4 as the next outcome-blind fresh role-capacity holdout is superseded; 5x4 outcomes had already been observed under EW-RS-050 and now provide transfer-only context.
Total capacity and unordered capacity-profile augmentation are insufficient on the hardest derivation carriers; role alignment is the required seam.
The coarsest selected capacity grade is parity, not zero/odd/even or exact capacity.
nonclaims: ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE is not proved minimal among all structural identities.
The result is Q-V only and does not establish Q-A or Q-F.
No standard-7x6 or universal theorem follows.
The scalar decoder inside the compressed coordinate remains to be derived.
next_question: What is the simplest outcome-independent scalar decoding law over ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE classes, and can it be expressed without fitted exact-component IDs?
